:::{#thm-log-partition-variance}
#### The variance of the statistic is the second derivative of the log-partition function

Let $\Rvar$ have a [distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) in an [exponential family](#def-exponential-family)
with [natural parameter](#def-natural-parameter) $\natparam$,
[statistic](sufficiency.qmd#def-statistic) $\stat$,
and log-partition function $\logpartition$,
and let $\natparam$ be in the interior of the allowed values.
Then

$$
\Var{\statf{\Rvar}} = \dif{^2 \logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam^2}.
$$

:::

::: proof

The solution to @exr-log-partition-second-derivative,
worked in @sol-log-partition-second-derivative,
proves the statement.
It uses @thm-log-partition-mean.

:::
